disposition_reason: Nine elements including As, Cd, Hg and Pb were measured by ICP-OES in 36 Taftoon, Lavash and Sangak breads from Zahedan bakeries; Table 4 gives mean, min and max per bread type, but its unit label conflicts with its magnitudes.

study.design: Cross-sectional bakery survey with HQ/HI and ELCR risk assessment
study.market: 6 bakeries in each of 6 municipal districts, Zahedan, Sistan and Baluchistan, Iran
study.method: Oven-dried 50 °C 48 h, ground; HNO3/H2O2 hot-plate digestion; ICP-OES (Spectro Arcos)
study.lod_text: MDL range 0.01 'Lg/kg' (Cd) to 9.5 mg/kg (Zn), as printed
study.qa: Duplicate analyses, CV < 3%; spike recoveries 98-103% (Methods) or 86-98% (Table 4); no CRM
